lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by sharp horizontal luminance gradients with highlights on the superior aspect and shadows on the inferior aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs, primarily localized in the basal and anterior-central regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white protrusions or possible parasitic lesions on the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin; minor irregular notch on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-density, stochastic distribution of smaller white spots that contrasts with the geometric organization of the lateral flank pattern.
